name: equity-research-agent
description: Autonomous Equity Research Agent: FastAPI backend (backend/) + Next.js frontend (frontend/), run locally

scripts.dev:backend: cross-env PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --directory backend uvicorn equity_agent.api:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.start:backend: cross-env PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --directory backend uvicorn equity_agent.api:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:start:backend" "npm:start:frontend"
scripts.gen:types: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py .cache/openapi.json && openapi-typescript backend/.cache/openapi.json -o frontend/src/lib/types.ts
